subject: Drilling Operations - Grand Manan - Saint John Harbour
text:
Drilling Operations - Grand Manan - Saint John Harbour
Drilling operations underway at Saint John Ferry Terminal from October 18 to November 18, 2026. Barge and workboat onsite will be operating 24 hours daily. Orange buoys will mark 4 barge anchor positions. Low wake and wide berth requested. Caution.
